chip.description: PowerVR2 (CLX2) tile-based deferred 3D renderer at the core of the Dreamcast/NAOMI HOLLY system ASIC; draws from display lists into a framebuffer (V2).
chip.notes: Designed by VideoLogic (Imagination Technologies), fabricated by NEC. The HOLLY package also carries the Maple and G2 bus controllers, which MAME models as separate devices (ignored here as on-die blocks).
